Abrir en CAD todas las piezas de este pr: Open every part of this project in CAD
Abrir un ensamble (.bench.json) de un pr: Open an assembly (.bench.json) from a project, or a .zip from the computer
Acopla una sub-malla LBM D2Q9+Smagorinsk: Couples a D2Q9 + Smagorinsky LBM sub-grid (the same LBM2D class) that adds fine turbulence to the smoke, using Helmholtz decomposition and Taylor's hypothesis.
Activar: clic en la pieza a fijar: Activate: click the part to fix
Activar: clic en la pieza donde va la ca: Activate: click the part that takes the load
Agrega un péndulo listo para simular: Adds a pendulum ready to simulate
Ajusta boquilla, extrusor, relleno, sopo: Set the nozzle, extruder, infill, supports and slicing mode (planar, diagonal or elliptic).
Ajuste al volumen - Capas totales - Bloq: Fit to volume · total layers · PRIM REVOLVE blocks · layers covered by primitives
Albedo, normal, rugosidad, metalicidad y: Albedo, normal, roughness, metalness and AO (the type is recognised from the file name)
Anima todos los canales activados entre: Animates every enabled channel between its minimum and maximum
Análisis por elementos finitos (FEA, con: Finite element analysis (FEA, with CalculiX) and fluid analysis (wind and flow CFD) on imported parts: simulation tree, mesh, loads and supports, and results.
Aplica todas las soluciones en vista pre: Previews every solution without confirming them
Arranque suave de R/Z/E (pasos de rampa,: Soft start for R/Z/E (ramp steps, 0 = no ramp)
Arriba hay pestañas de modo (Proyecto, C: Mode tabs run along the top (Project, Kinematics, Simulation, Electronics, Control); each one changes the button ribbon and the left panel. On the right, a rail of icons opens sliding panels (Project, Interferences, Material, Properties, Relations, Mesh diagnosis).
Banco de ensamble: importa piezas STL o: Assembly bench: imports parts from STL or from a project, joins them with mates, checks interferences, simulates kinematics and physics, and connects electronics and control (panels, boards, wiring, PLC/ladder).
Borra las juntas creadas por la detecció: Deletes the joints created by detection
Cada pieza como.stl independiente, ya po: Each part as a separate .stl, already in position
Calcula y acepta todas las soluciones au: Computes and accepts every solution automatically
Carga la pieza y genera la malla en la p: Load the part and generate the mesh in the Mesh tab. Check the diagnosis before going on.
Cargar y ajustar al volumen de trabajo: Load and fit to the work volume
Copia color, acabado y mapas de la pieza: Copies colour, finish and maps from the active part
Corta la pieza importada con un plano pe: Cuts the imported part with a plane normal to X and precomputes the LBM analysis on that screen (it fades towards the edge). It can be combined with Y and Z.
Cuts the imported part with a plane normal to Y and precomputes the LBM analysis on that screen. It can be combined with X and Z at the same time.
Cuts the imported part with a plane normal to Z (plan view) and precomputes the LBM analysis on that screen. It can be combined with X and Y at the same time.
Desde PolarSlicer pulsa «Enviar a Machin: In PolarSlicer press «Send to Machin», or open a G-code or S-code file.
Detecta ciclos y scripts con errores: Detects loops and scripts with errors
Devuelve las piezas a donde estaban ante: Puts the parts back where they were before simulating
El panel izquierdo es un acordeón: cada: The left panel is an accordion: each screenshot shows one section open with its subsections. The final «Slice and generate S-code» button becomes active once a part is loaded.
Elegir la pieza de un proyecto del Gesto: Pick the part from a project in the Manager (with preview). The S-code is saved as a branch under its STL.
Elige la máquina en el selector junto a: Choose the machine in the selector next to «Send to Machin». The output switches between G-code and S-code by itself, according to its kinematics.
En CFD elige viento o flujo, define la v: In CFD choose wind or flow, set the speed and run the simulation.
En Cinemática revisa las juntas y usa «R: In Kinematics check the joints and use «Solve mechanism» for closed-loop mechanisms.
En Control programa la escalera, pasa a: In Control program the ladder, switch to RUN and watch the machine and the circuit respond.
En Electrónica agrega fuentes, PLC, sens: In Electronics add power supplies, PLCs, sensors and actuators, and wire them.
En FEA asigna material, apoyos y cargas,: In FEA assign material, supports and loads, and compute stresses and strains.
En Resultados recorre los campos con la: In Results go through the fields with the colour scale and export the images you need.
En el menú Máquina elige otra máquina St: In the Machine menu choose another Stonward machine, or use «Acquire new machine» to install a .zip package.
En el menú lateral entra a Análisis: se: In the side menu go to Analysis: Analizer opens.
En el menú lateral entra a Laboratorio:: In the side menu go to Laboratory: the test bench opens.
En el menú lateral entra a Laminador: se: In the side menu go to Slicer: PolarSlicer opens.
En el menú lateral entra a Maquinado: se: In the side menu go to Machining: Machin opens with the default machine, PolarONE.
Generar demo cinematográfico (recorrido: Generate a cinematic demo (a ~26 s tour with a camera script and captions) and export it to video
Gravedad, contacto y fricción. Pulsa otr: Gravity, contact and friction. Press again to pause
Guardar el ensamble en su proyecto (.ben: Save the assembly in its project (.bench.json) · Ctrl+S · Ctrl+Shift+S = Save as
Humo Navier–Stokes: se advecta con el ca: Navier–Stokes smoke: advected with the truly solved 3D field (RK2) instead of the simple analytic swirl.
Importa el ensamble de PolarCAD. Sus pie: Import the assembly from PolarCAD. Its parts keep their names and positions.
Importa la pieza en STL y acomódala en e: Import the part as STL and place it on the disc or the bed.
Importar archivos o una carpeta completa: Import files or a whole folder (STEP/IGS/STL/OBJ/SVG/DXF/PDF)
Importar piezas de CAD desde un proyecto: Import CAD parts from a project, with preview (one, or all the parts in a folder)
Importar uno o varios archivos STL del e: Import one or more STL files from the computer
Importar.stl sueltos o un.zip de proyect: Import loose .stl files or a BENCH project .zip
Incluir datos de extrusor en el S-code: Include extruder data in the S-code
Interactuar (I · o Alt+clic): usa la sim: Interact (I, or Alt+click): use the simulation without selecting or moving parts. Press buttons, turn knobs, press ladder contacts
La turbina axial completa (geometría, ma: The full axial turbine (geometry, materials, 3D Navier–Stokes with coupled LBM and real smoke). It reacts to the real imported part, not to a placeholder object
Las pestañas de arriba cambian la cinta: The tabs at the top change the button ribbon; the simulation tree and the Data panel (turbine, graphs, monitoring points) stay in place. Buttons with an orange dot and the title «Coming soon» are not connected yet.
Las piezas seleccionadas caen y chocan a: The selected parts fall and collide when simulating
Las piezas seleccionadas no se mueven co: The selected parts are not moved by physics
Lista las relaciones cinemáticas que Lab: Lists the kinematic relations Laboratory recognises (lead screw + nut, rail + carriage, gears, shafts…) so you can apply them
MIA: clic para hablar, clic derecho para: MIA: click to talk, right-click to type
Medir distancia entre dos puntos: Measure the distance between two points
Modo manual: pegar datos BP/FD a mano: Manual mode: paste BP/FD data by hand
Música para el demo (opcional): clic = e: Music for the demo (optional): click = choose file · right-click = remove
Ocultar / mostrar panel de piezas y mate: Hide / show the parts and mates panel
Ocultar referencias (grilla, ejes, conto: Hide references (grid, axes, selection and interference outlines)
PRUEBA sin extrusor: la máquina real cop: TEST without extruder: the real machine copies θ, R and Z from the virtual one, but does not extrude
Pantalla completa recién abierto (pestañ: Full screen, just opened (Project tab, Material submode)
Para mover la máquina real, conecta el c: To move the real machine, connect the controller over USB and open communication in the left panel.
Pega la apariencia copiada en la selecci: Pastes the copied appearance onto the selection
Por capas (bloque bajo cada voladizo): By layers (a block under each overhang)
Prepara una pieza STL para imprimir en l: Prepares an STL part for printing on the polar machine: it places it on the disc, slices it into layers and generates the S-code (polar kinematics θ, r, z), which you download or send to Machin.
Proyecto: el mismo panel de CAD (proyect: Project: the same panel as in CAD (projects, parts, Library). Double-click a part to bring it into Laboratory with its name, colour and material.
Próximamente — Fase 0 no calcula cortant: Coming soon: phase 0 does not compute shear yet
Próximamente — depende de CFD Viento: Coming soon: depends on CFD Wind
Pulsa reproducir para simular la trayect: Press play to simulate the path with the real kinematics. The traffic light warns you if any point is out of reach.
Péndulo: la pieza activa oscila desde su: Pendulum: the active part swings from its top edge (with Ctrl, pick the support first)
Quita mapas y vuelve al plástico mate: Removes maps and goes back to matte plastic
Rebana, revisa capa por capa con el desl: Slice, check layer by layer with the slider and send the result to Machin.
Recorre la línea de tiempo y reporta col: Runs through the timeline and reports collisions and limits
Relleno de soportes (%) · vacío = igual: Support infill (%) · empty = same as the part
Resorte entre 2 piezas: primero el sopor: Spring between 2 parts: first the support, then with Ctrl the one that hangs
SD-M5 Centro de mecanizado de 5 ejes, pu: SD-M5 5-axis machining centre, moving gantry and A trunnion
SD-R7 Brazo de 6 ejes para impresión 3D: SD-R7 6-axis arm for 3D printing + Ø300 polar table
Sacar como ventana flotante: Pop out as a floating window
Simulador y control de la máquina: carga: Machine simulator and control: it loads an S-code (.scode) from the polar slicer, plays it back in 3D on the active machine and sends it to the real machine over Bluetooth, WiFi or USB.
Sin controles propios: los que se ven es: No controls of its own: the ones you see are listed in another section.
Solo desde la cama (nunca apoyados sobre: Only from the bed (never resting on the part)
Suma la masa de todas las piezas con mat: Adds up the mass of every part with a material assigned
Sólidos reales vía kernel CadQuery/OCCT: Real solids through the CadQuery/OCCT kernel
Un bloque que resbala por un plano incli: A block sliding down an inclined plane
Un solo STL fusionado con las piezas vis: A single STL merging the visible parts
Una arandela que cae a lo largo de un tu: A washer falling along a tube
Usar botones, perillas y deslizadores en: Use buttons, knobs and sliders in the viewer (I)
Velocidad automática (mira la ruta; la d: Automatic speed (reads the path; the value above is the limit)
Vista cinemática: cámara dramática + ilu: Cinematic view: dramatic camera + workshop lighting
